lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: did you ride AZX today?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Guess not.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If you had, I was gonna ask you something.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I thought I saw you at Royal Road Station.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Anyway, forget I said anything.
What do you want to ask me?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Actually,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: we received a report today

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: about a strange individual

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: spreading vicious rumors about a murder

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: that has taken place on the train.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: All we have for a description is that they were holding some kind of telescope.
Oh my.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: By the time I arrived on site,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: the mysterious passenger was nowhere to be found.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I can't determine whether the report has any truth to it.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: That's why I thought I could ask you whether you had noticed anyone unusual.
Aren't there surveillance cameras on the train?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Unfortunately, thanks to a screw-up by one of our employees,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: all the cameras were down during the time the mystery passenger showed up.
I see.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: There's nothing we can do but

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: fix our surveillance cameras

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: and wait for this person to show up again.
What do they look like?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: but I heard it was a female. Apparently, she was

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: wearing a beret and a plaid shirt.
Did she talk as if she were a detective?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Not sure about that,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: but I was told she spoke in a rather peculiar manner.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Is she someone you know?
Potentially.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Does she strike you as the kind of person

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: who would launch a terrorist attack?
Definitely not.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Are you positive?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: There was another terrorist attack against the AFX.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: So everyone's on edge.
I'm 100% certain that she is not a terrorist.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Hmmm...
She's just a self-professed detective who's always hot on one case or another.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I suppose those are all my questions for now.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If you say you trust her,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll take your word for it.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: However, to prevent such things from happening again,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll have the surveillance cameras fixed and security tightened.
Good idea.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Also, please tell your friend that

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: if she goes around

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: creating a public disturbance

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: by spreading rumors again,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: she won't be so lucky next time.
I'll do that.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Talk to you soon.
Sorry for disrupting your work.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Don't worry.
I need to remind Novel to take it easy.
